name: Outrider Joss
title: Waykeeper
examine: A Waykeeper of the road service. The grey does the thinking on bad ground, and Joss lets her.
lines: Road's open to the low country. Two bridges, one bad shoulder. Keep your lamp trimmed.
The watch holds the wall. We hold the road. Longer post, ours.
Ask Osa at the High Yard if you want a horse of your own. She does the shoeing. I do the sitting.
